page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin: fragments of notes, cut off at the scan edge. Right margin: stamp and show-through marks, not transcribed. Bottom: gathering signature at left and catchword at right.

main_text.p: apud Athenienses locum habuisse, & de praescriptis agere in judicio non licuisse.
main_text.head: De classibus civium ditiorum Atheniensium, & instruendis subitò triremibus & permutandis facultatibus.
main_text.p: iussu[?]DE classibus & lege trierarchicâ dixi ante in descriptione reipublicae Atticae. Heic facere non possum, quin de instructione triremis, & permutatione facultatum ex oratore nostro in ea,quę est contra Phaenippum, quae tota hujus materiae est, adjiciam. Erant συμμο-ίαι Athenis civium ditiorum numero xx, singulae capitum lx. Ex omnibus his conficiebatur classis una civium ccc, qui censebantur ditissimi totius civitatis. Iis injungebantur munia difficillima obeunda in casibus & periculis repentinis, ut triremes singulas singulis instruerent pecuniâ suâ, & alia hujus generis. Quam rationem rudem olim, & vacillantem, & suo tempore vitiatam multis modis collapsamque Demosthenes ingruente metu belli Perficilan[?] latâ lege non solum revocavit in usum, sed etiam meliorem fecit, ut ipse in oratione de coronâ ostendit: ipsam verò emendandi rationem ac modum in oratione περὶ συμμοριῶν exposuit. Per-
{i} Fragments of marginal notes at the left edge, partly cut off, read as far as possible: "mo.", "con.", "ha.", "le.", "ut.", "s", "ut." ([?] on all).

page.notes: Left margin fragments (iussu, lan, mo, con, ha, le, ut, and others at the scan edge) are cut off and read only partly; their placement in the paragraphs is approximate. Right-margin red and pink marks are stamps and show-through and are not transcribed. Greek words are copied with accents as far as visible; the hyphenated word "συμμο-ίαι" is split at the line end. The final line of the page is "Per-", with the catchword "mitte" below it. Long s is printed as s and is normalised to s throughout.
